title: SEBI floats proposal to revamp ETF price band framework
theme: SEBI floats proposal to revamp ETF price band framework
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: SEBI floats proposal to revamp ETF price band framework
constituentArticles.text: SEBI proposed shifting ETF base price from T-2 closing NAV to T-1 data/iNAV with dynamic price bands (10-20% equity/debt, 6-20% gold/silver, 5% overnight).

keyFacts: SEBI proposed shifting ETF base price from T-2 closing NAV to T-1 data/iNAV with dynamic price bands (10-20% equity/debt, 6-20% gold/silver, 5% overnight).
